Select IC50 activity records with provenance for CHEMBL4857685 and its salt forms against target CHEMBL240. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL4857685 to retrieve all related forms. Join compound_records and docs to obtain compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi. Join activities and assays to retrieve IC50 records and assay descriptions. Join target_dictionary to get target details. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Filter for standard_type IC50 and target CHEMBL240. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
